title: Ordinary proper/open lambda coefficient square
statement: The ordinary pre-completion coefficient square holds for the properOpenLambda generator, after expanding its cartesian, restriction, clopen and direct-image compositor factors and pasting their structural adjunction squares.

source.place: Proper/open lambda coefficient-square expansion, split-off intermediate statement.

proof.text: Expand the prescribed four-factor lambda in the ordinary ringed and system categories. Apply the structural unit, counit, pullback compositor, open comparison and proper/open mate squares to each factor, then paste them.

lean.statement:
theorem properOpenLambdaOrdinarySquare
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} (Cf : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic Cf.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic Cf.l) E] (o : Operations Cf.l E)
    {S : Type s} (W : S → Scheme.{u}) (hW : FiniteTypeFamily W D.k)
    {I : Type i} (location : I → S)
    {a b c d : S}
      (k : W a ⟶ W b) (r : W a ⟶ W c) (p : W b ⟶ W d) (j : W c ⟶ W d)
      (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ j) (hk : IsOpenImmersion k) (hki : QuasiCompact k)
      (hjo : IsOpenImmersion j) (hji : QuasiCompact j)
      (hr : IsProper r) (hp : IsProper p) (B : Word W location a)
    (K : ∀ k : I, DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource Cf.l E (W (location k)))) :
    properOpenOrdinaryR Cf.l E location o K
        (Word.pull j (by let := hjo; infer_instance) (by let := hjo; infer_instance)
          hji (Word.push p (by let := hp; infer_instance) (by let := hp; infer_instance)
            (by let := hp; infer_instance) hp (Word.open k hk hki B))) ≫
        (GeneratorKind.properOpenLambda k r p j h hk hki hjo hji hr hp B).systemMap
          Cf.l E W location o (inputReduction Cf.l E W location K) =
      (IntegralSystemRealization.calculus Cf.l E (W c)).reduction.map
          ((GeneratorKind.properOpenLambda k r p j h hk hki hjo hji hr hp B).ringedMap
            Cf.l E W location o K) ≫
        properOpenOrdinaryR Cf.l E location o K
          (Word.push r (by let := hr; infer_instance) (by let := hr; infer_instance)
            (by let := hr; infer_instance) hr B)
